Overview.title: Overview
Overview.intro: What happened in the server lately, and whether the bot is running.
Overview.noCases: No cases yet. They appear here when someone is warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

BotStatus.title: Bot status
BotStatus.offlineHint: The dashboard can't reach the bot. It may be restarting.

Moderation.title: Cases
Moderation.intro: Every warning, timeout, kick and ban, whether it came from a command, this dashboard or Discord itself.

search.label: Search cases
search.placeholder: Name, user ID, reason or case number

empty.title: No cases yet
empty.body: Cases appear here when someone is warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

noMatch.title: No cases match
noMatch.body: Try another search or clear the filters.

detail.title: Case #{number}
detail.moreNone: No other cases for this member.
detail.searchMember: Search all cases for this member

pardon.title: Pardon this warning?
pardon.body: It stays in the history, marked as pardoned, and the log message in Discord is updated.
pardon.doneNoLog: Warning pardoned. The log message in Discord couldn't be updated.

errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.
errors.notActiveWarning: That isn't an active warning any more.
errors.failed: Couldn't pardon the warning. Try again.

settings.title: Moderation settings
settings.intro: Where cases are posted in Discord and whether members are told.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.logChannelHelp: Every case is posted here as an embed. Cases are recorded either way.
settings.botOffline: The bot is offline, so the channel list isn't available. Your current channel is kept until you can pick a new one.
settings.dm: Message members when they're warned, timed out, kicked or banned
settings.dmHelp: If a member has direct messages closed, the action still goes through.
settings.savedBotLater: Settings saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks them up within a minute.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can change these settings.
errors.botUnavailable: Can't reach the bot to check that channel. Try again in a moment.
errors.channelNotFound: That channel doesn't exist, or the bot can't see it.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the settings. Try again.

TempVoice.title: Voice rooms
TempVoice.intro: Members who join the lobby get a room of their own. See the rooms that are open now and change how new rooms are made.

monitor.title: Open rooms
monitor.summary: {rooms, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} with {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in them

empty.title: No rooms open
empty.body: A room appears when someone joins the lobby and disappears when it is empty.

off.title: Temporary rooms are switched off
off.body: Joining the lobby does nothing right now. Turn them on in the settings below.

monitor.offline: The dashboard can't reach the bot, so the live view isn't available.
monitor.noPeople: Nobody is in the room right now
monitor.missingBody: It can't create or manage rooms until its role has: {list}. Give it these on the lobby's category.

settings.title: Settings
settings.botOffline: The bot is offline, so the channel lists aren't available. Your saved channels are kept.
settings.enabledHelp: When off, joining the lobby does nothing. Open rooms are still deleted once they are empty.
settings.lobbyHelp: The voice channel members join to get their own room.
settings.categoryHelp: New rooms are created here. Leave it empty to put them next to the lobby.
settings.defaultLimitHelp: 0 means no limit. Owners can change it for their own room.
settings.video: Allow video and screen sharing in new rooms
settings.soundboard: Allow the soundboard in new rooms
settings.defaultsHelp: Owners can switch these for their own room.
settings.blockedHelp: Room names containing one of these are refused. One per line or separated by commas. Capital letters and invisible characters don't get around it.
settings.savedBotLater: Settings saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks them up within a minute.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can change these settings.
errors.invalid: Some of these values aren't valid.
errors.needsLobby: Pick a lobby channel before switching temporary rooms on.
errors.botUnavailable: Can't reach the bot to check those channels. Try again in a moment.
errors.lobbyNotFound: That lobby isn't a voice channel the bot can see.
errors.categoryNotFound: That category doesn't exist, or the bot can't see it.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the settings. Try again.

Errors.loadFailedBody: Something went wrong while loading it. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, the dashboard's log has the details.
